genres.label: Action
genres.tagline: High-octane thrills, amazing animation, and fast-paced storytelling.

anime.title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners
anime.description: A visually stunning, heartbreaking, and adrenaline-fueled ride set in the futuristic Night City. A street kid fights to survive in a world obsessed with power and body modification.

anime.title: One Punch Man
anime.description: A hilarious and beautifully animated take on the superhero genre where the main character defeats every enemy with a single punch — and is utterly bored by it.

anime.title: Chainsaw Man
anime.description: A cinematic, chaotic, and bloody modern hit about a down-on-his-luck guy who merges with a chainsaw demon and is pulled into a brutal world of devil hunters.

anime.title: Mob Psycho 100
anime.description: From the creator of One Punch Man — a socially awkward middle-schooler with god-like psychic powers tries to live a normal life while suppressing emotions that could level a city.

anime.title: Vivy: Fluorite Eye's Song
anime.description: An AI pop idol is sent 100 years into the past to alter key historical events and prevent a devastating war between humans and artificial intelligence.

anime.title: Lycoris Recoil
anime.description: A secret organization of teenage girl assassins keeps Tokyo's peace from a café front. Think John Wick gun-fu meets cute cafe slice-of-life.

anime.title: Hell's Paradise
anime.description: A group of death-row criminals are sent to a beautiful but horrific island to find the elixir of life in exchange for a pardon. Not everyone will make it back.

anime.title: Akudama Drive
anime.description: A colorful, high-stakes cyberpunk heist where a group of elite criminals are assembled to pull off the ultimate job in a neon-drenched dystopian Japan.

anime.title: Solo Leveling
anime.description: In a world where monster-hunting Hunters exist, the absolute weakest one discovers a secret system that lets him level up endlessly while everyone else stays the same.

anime.title: Deca-Dence
anime.description: A post-apocalyptic action show with a massive twist — humanity lives inside a giant mobile fortress battling monsters, but nothing is quite what it seems.

genres.label: Romance
genres.tagline: Sweet, funny, and emotional stories about love and connection.

anime.title: Horimiya
anime.description: A breath of fresh air in the romance genre — skips the endless will-they-won't-they and focuses on two students finding real comfort in each other's hidden sides.

anime.title: My Dress-Up Darling
anime.description: A lonely traditional doll-maker and a bubbly popular girl form an unlikely bond when she ropes him into making her elaborate cosplay outfits.

anime.title: Wotakoi: Love is Hard for Otaku
anime.description: A relatable and funny adult romance about coworkers hiding their nerdy hobbies — gaming, manga, and all — while trying to date each other without anyone finding out.

anime.title: Tomo-chan Is a Girl!
anime.description: A hilarious rom-com about a tomboy desperately trying to get her oblivious childhood best friend to see her as a woman — and not just his bro.

anime.title: A Sign of Affection
anime.description: A beautifully animated, deeply sweet romance between a deaf college student and a well-traveled multilingual guy who literally stops to help her in a crowd.

anime.title: Tsuki ga Kirei
anime.description: One of the most realistic, grounded, and genuinely wholesome depictions of awkward middle-school first love ever animated. Simple, honest, and quietly beautiful.

anime.title: Recovery of an MMO Junkie
anime.description: A 30-something woman quits her corporate job to play MMOs full-time and accidentally falls in love with a guildmate who keeps crossing her path in real life.

anime.title: The Dangers in My Heart
anime.description: Starts with an edgy middle schooler convinced he's a villain, but quickly melts into one of the most heartwarming and genuinely funny romances in recent years.

anime.title: Shikimori's Not Just a Cutie
anime.description: A fluffy role-reversal romance where the boyfriend has the world's worst luck and his cool, athletic, effortlessly stylish girlfriend is constantly showing up to save him.

anime.title: Don't Toy With Me, Miss Nagatoro
anime.description: A mischievous, teasing underclassman latches onto a quiet, nerdy upperclassman artist and slowly — very slowly — the teasing becomes something a lot more genuine.

genres.label: Isekai
genres.tagline: Transported to another world — fantasy, magic, and RPG mechanics await.

anime.title: No Game No Life
anime.description: Two genius gamer siblings are transported to a vibrant fantasy world where everything — from borders to lives — is settled by playing games. They've never lost.

anime.title: KonoSuba: God's Blessing on this Wonderful World!
anime.description: The funniest isekai ever made. A cynical teenager and his party of spectacularly useless teammates stumble through a fantasy world achieving absolutely nothing gracefully.

anime.title: The Devil is a Part-Timer!
anime.description: A reverse isekai — the terrifying Demon Lord flees to modern-day Tokyo and ends up working at a fast-food burger joint just trying to pay rent. Genuinely hilarious.

anime.title: Grimgar of Fantasy and Ash
anime.description: A grounded, realistic isekai where the characters aren't overpowered heroes — they're scared kids struggling just to survive and kill low-level goblins for coin.

anime.title: My Next Life as a Villainess
anime.description: A girl reincarnates as the villain of her favorite dating-sim game and must desperately avoid every bad ending that leads to her doom — while accidentally charming everyone around her.

anime.title: Campfire Cooking in Another World
anime.description: A relaxing isekai about a normal guy whose only magic skill is ordering groceries online from modern Japan. He uses it to cook incredible meals for legendary monsters.

anime.title: Saga of Tanya the Evil
anime.description: A ruthless, calculating Japanese salaryman is reincarnated as a magical little girl in an alternate-universe World War I. She proceeds to be terrifyingly competent.

anime.title: Uncle from Another World
anime.description: A man wakes from a 17-year coma and reveals to his nephew that he spent that entire time trapped in a fantasy world — and he has the magic and footage to prove it.

anime.title: Cautious Hero: The Hero Is Overpowered but Overly Cautious
anime.description: A goddess summons a ridiculously powerful hero to save a world, but he refuses to take a single step until he is one thousand percent over-prepared for anything.

anime.title: Drifters
anime.description: Famous historical figures — samurai, outlaws, generals — are pulled from their timelines into a fantasy world and forced to wage war against a dark empire.

genres.label: Psychological
genres.tagline: Mind-bending mysteries, dark twists, and deep human nature.

anime.title: Death Parade
anime.description: When two people die at the same time, they're sent to a mysterious bar to play games — darts, billiards, bowling — that determine whether their soul is reincarnated or erased.

anime.title: Erased
anime.description: A struggling manga artist is involuntarily sent back to his childhood to prevent a serial killer from murdering his classmate — and stop a tragedy that defined his life.

anime.title: The Promised Neverland
anime.description: Three genius orphans discover a dark, horrifying secret about their idyllic orphanage and must plan a massive escape without letting on that they know. Season 1 is a masterpiece.

anime.title: Odd Taxi
anime.description: Don't let the animal characters fool you. A brilliant, Tarantino-esque mystery thriller built around a cynical walrus taxi driver whose passengers are all hiding something.

anime.title: Terror in Resonance
anime.description: Two mysterious teenage boys steal a prototype nuclear device and begin a cryptic cat-and-mouse game of riddles and terrorism against the Tokyo police.

anime.title: Puella Magi Madoka Magica
anime.description: Looks like a cute, standard magical girl show. It is not. Within a few episodes it becomes one of the most psychologically dark and genre-redefining anime ever made.

anime.title: ID: Invaded
anime.description: A sci-fi detective thriller where investigators dive into the literal subconscious minds of serial killers, navigating fractured dreamscapes to identify them before they kill again.

anime.title: Tomodachi Game
anime.description: A group of close friends is kidnapped and forced into a series of psychological games to pay off a massive debt — slowly dismantling everything they thought they knew about each other.

anime.title: Kakegurui
anime.description: An elite academy where the entire social hierarchy is determined by high-stakes gambling. A transfer student arrives who doesn't play to win money — she plays because she's addicted to the thrill.

anime.title: Classroom of the Elite
anime.description: A prestigious school where students are ranked and must compete using any means necessary. The quiet, seemingly ordinary protagonist is playing a very different game than everyone else.

genres.label: Comedy
genres.tagline: Pure laughs, absurd situations, and unforgettable character dynamics.

anime.title: Kaguya-sama: Love is War
anime.description: Two genius student council leaders have massive crushes on each other but are too proud to confess — so they wage elaborate psychological warfare to make the other crack first.

anime.title: Grand Blue Dreaming
anime.description: Technically about a college scuba diving club. Actually a relentless, laugh-out-loud comedy about drinking competitions, peer pressure, and absolutely unhinged misunderstandings.

anime.title: Asobi Asobase
anime.description: Three middle school girls playing pastime games — on paper it sounds mild. In reality it's one of the most chaotic, unhinged, and brilliantly executed comedies ever animated.

anime.title: Hinamatsuri
anime.description: A mid-level Yakuza member's carefully organized life is wrecked when a deadpan girl with telekinetic powers crash-lands in his apartment and refuses to leave.

anime.title: Bocchi the Rock!
anime.description: A masterpiece of visual comedy about a severely socially anxious girl who can only express herself through guitar — and somehow ends up in a band that plays live shows.

anime.title: Mashle: Magic and Muscles
anime.description: Imagine a meathead with zero magical ability attending a school like Hogwarts — and solving every magical problem by punching it hard enough. A love letter to shonen absurdity.

anime.title: Daily Lives of High School Boys
anime.description: A sketch comedy classic that perfectly nails the dumb, harmless, and genuinely hilarious things teenage boys do with their time when absolutely nothing important is happening.

anime.title: Haven't You Heard? I'm Sakamoto
anime.description: A high school student so absurdly perfect, stylish, and composed that every mundane thing he does — including sweeping a floor or dodging a bee — becomes blindingly cool.

anime.title: Sleepy Princess in the Demon Castle
anime.description: A kidnapped human princess has zero interest in being rescued. She just wants the perfect night's sleep and will absolutely terrorize her demon captors to get it.

anime.title: The Disastrous Life of Saiki K.
anime.description: A high schooler with every psychic power imaginable wants only one thing — to be left alone and eat coffee jelly in peace. The universe refuses to cooperate. Relentlessly funny.

genres.label: Slice of Life
genres.tagline: Relaxing, slow-paced stories about everyday life, hobbies, and growth.

anime.title: Laid-Back Camp
anime.description: The peak of comfy anime. Just girls going winter camping, eating good food, and enjoying breathtaking scenery. There is no conflict. There doesn't need to be.

anime.title: Barakamon
anime.description: An arrogant young calligrapher punches a critic and gets exiled to a rural island. The quirky, warm villagers — especially one chaotic little girl — slowly change him completely.

anime.title: A Place Further Than the Universe
anime.description: An inspiring, genuinely emotional show about four high school girls who decide — against all odds — to join a real expedition to Antarctica together.

anime.title: Violet Evergarden
anime.description: Possibly the most visually beautiful anime ever made. A child soldier learns what it means to be human by ghostwriting emotional letters for strangers across the world.

anime.title: Flying Witch
anime.description: A teenage witch moves to the countryside. The magic is gentle and whimsical, the pace is slow and warm, and the whole show feels like a long exhale on a quiet afternoon.

anime.title: Sweetness & Lightning
anime.description: A recently widowed single father learns how to cook proper, loving meals for his young daughter with the help of one of his students. Quietly heartwarming.

anime.title: Tanaka-kun is Always Listless
anime.description: A relaxing comedy about a boy whose only ambition in life is to be as perfectly, transcendently lazy as possible — and the friends who carry him around and enable it.

anime.title: Usagi Drop
anime.description: A 30-year-old bachelor steps up to adopt his grandfather's young illegitimate daughter when the rest of the family shuns her. A tender, grounded story about unexpected family.

anime.title: Non Non Biyori
anime.description: Daily life in a remote countryside school where students of all ages share one classroom, the nearest convenience store is miles away, and time moves at a different pace entirely.

anime.title: My Roommate is a Cat
anime.description: A socially anxious novelist adopts a stray cat. Half the episode is from his perspective. The other half is hilariously retold from the cat's completely different point of view.
